item.risk_statement: A digest or reference could be replaced, or a canonical source could be impersonated.
item.required_control: Bind algorithm, version, source and subject; reject tamper and never silently repair.

item.risk_statement: A replayed or duplicate package could be presented as a new successful execution.
item.required_control: Use unique package identity, time policy, deduplication and immutable replay status.

item.risk_statement: Cross-tenant or cross-entity binding could disclose data or misattribute identity.
item.required_control: Require tenant and subject binding, authorization checks and correlation conflict rejection.

item.risk_statement: A compromised or expired issuer or verifier identity could remain trusted.
item.required_control: Bind issuer status, validity interval, revocation reference and incident response path.

item.risk_statement: Raw payloads, credentials, secrets or sensitive content could enter a portable package.
item.required_control: Deny content by default and require allowlists, redaction, secret scans and stop conditions.
